__comment: Storage Shelf - the WYSIWYG container (doc 19): contents render ON the shelf at the
anchor points below, capacity == anchor count (never hold more than is visible).
placement 'floor_wall': the BACK face (local z=0 edge, the solid back panel) must
stand against a solid block. anchors are furniture-local block coords (origin =
bottom-front-left, same convention as collision_regions); anchor_scale is the stored
item render scale - 0.5 per SH ATTITEM parity (2026-07-11), tune-by-eye dial.
description: Two stout plank shelves on heavy oak uprights. Everything stored on it stays in plain sight.
